bareRockRendering: excluded: source mask lies wholly on water in current coastline snapshot; no island invented
surfaceGeometry: mapped beaches clipped to land and draped on unchanged terrain; overlapping grass removed

cliffs.collision: original conservative coast/terrain boundary; fractures decorative
cliffs.normals: shared indexed normals, outward faces; source lip/corners preserved
cliffs.wetBandGeometry: exclusive interpolated triangle partition, no overlapping wet sheet
cliffs.naturalRockMaterial: shared1024px periodic authored strata/fractures; sRGBalbedo/linear tangent normal and roughness; dry/wet material groups
cliffs.largeScaleShape: original sourcecoast and30mDSM retained; decorative face recess remains at most8cm inward
cliffs.verticalStepMeaning: maximum spacing within each vertical column; triangles following a sloping lip can span a greater total elevation

water.geometry: flat original mean water level; visual normals only
water.normalTexture: procedural warped periodic noise, not measured waves
water.animation: absolute simulation time; paused time produces same phase
water.nearshoreTintImplementation: single opaque ocean albedo field; no overlapping transparent water sheets

foamRepeat: integer tile count distributed along each closed ring, approximately11m per tile
